items.t: Transfer case locks up or fails
items.job: Replace transfer case with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report an average of about $3,800 for this repair. Checking fluid and the encoder motor first can rule out a cheaper fix.

items.t: Rear air suspension sags or the rear end drops
items.job: Replace rear air spring(s) or air suspension compressor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $504–$589 for one air spring. A coil-spring conversion kit is a cheaper alternative.

items.t: A/C stops blowing cold air
items.job: Diagnose A/C, fix leak or replace compressor, and recharge
items.note: Owners report an average of about $700.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or quits
items.job: Replace fuel pump module with fuel level sender
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,203–$1,380 for a fuel pump replacement. The tank must be dropped.

items.t: Cooling fan roars or engine runs hotter than normal
items.job: Replace electric cooling fan clutch

items.t: Flashing check engine light and misfire on the inline six
items.job: Replace ignition coil(s) and spark plugs
items.note: RepairPal lists about $191–$331 for one ignition coil.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold and gaskets

items.t: ABS and 4WD warning lights come on
items.job: Diagnose ABS and repair ground or wheel speed sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $122–$179 for ABS diagnosis alone.

items.t: Battery keeps going dead
items.job: Test charging system and battery drain; replace battery

items.t: Heater blower quits or won't shut off
items.job: Replace blower motor or blower control module
items.note: RepairPal lists about $299–$322 for a blower motor.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)

items.t: Front suspension clunks over bumps
items.job: Replace front stabilizer bar links and bushings

items.t: Groan or shudder when turning at low speed
items.job: Diagnose and change differential or transfer case fluid per bulletin

items.t: Outside door handle breaks
items.job: Replace outside door handle
items.note: Owners report an average of about $100.

items.t: Gas pump shuts off early when filling up
items.job: Diagnose fuel tank vent and vapor system and replace faulty part

items.t: Check engine light for an evaporative leak
items.job: Smoke-test EVAP system and replace leaking part

items.t: Power steering fluid leak at the steering gear
items.job: Replace pitman shaft seal or steering gear

items.t: Brakes squeak when pressing or releasing the pedal
items.job: Clean and lubricate brake hardware or replace pads

items.t: Driver's power window switch can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Driver window switch recall repair
items.note: Outside the recall, RepairPal lists about $483–$547 for a window switch.

items.t: Headlights can stop working (recall)
items.job: Headlamp recall repair

items.t: Power steering hose can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering hose (recall)

items.t: Tire information label has wrong data (recall)
items.job: Replace tire information label (recall)

items.t: Windshield may not be held in properly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reinstall windshield (recall)

items.t: Brake lights and rear turn signals may fail (recall)
items.job: Brake lamp recall repair

items.t: Turn signals may not work (recall)
items.job: Turn signal recall repair
